capabilities: stable official Canada ATIP portal identifier
bounded platform classification without automated interaction
manual-route only status preserved as a hard blocker
source URL preservation for future operator-reviewed evidence
archive handoff remains blocked until a lawful machine-readable source exists
limitations: the Canada ATIP Online Request portal is a request-submission form and does not expose a stable public general-purpose API for request, response, attachment, or timeline capture
automated request submission is outside scope because the portal carries identity, consent, and institution-selection obligations inappropriate for unattended capture
no public listing endpoint is documented for non-empty archive handoff evidence, so request-response-attachment capture remains unsupported in this repository
bounded capability verification is implementation readiness evidence, not legal evidence
explicit_route_assertion: platform id and route must be explicit and capture must not silently fall back to scraping, browser automation, or another provider
